comments: kernel3 + finetune + dropout (the 0.3757/0.3635 best) + flip_expand=True: instead of each __getitem__ randomly drawing one of 4 flip variants (identity/hflip/vflip/both) with a fresh coin-flip every call, KuRALSDataset now deterministically includes all 4 variants of every training frame as separate dataset entries each epoch (kurals/loaders/dataloaders.py's new flip_expand param) -- exhaustive rather than stochastic coverage of the same hflip/vflip transforms already in use, not a new augmentation type. nb_epochs/Tmax cut 300->75 (4x fewer) since flip_expand makes each epoch iterate 4x as many samples -- total iteration budget (and wall-clock time) matches the 300-epoch baseline runs, isolating exhaustive-vs-random flip coverage as the single variable rather than confounding it with 4x more training compute.
